brand: Past Due Desk · PayPal AI Hackathon · Design Master Solutions LLC

scenes.title: Overdue invoices, a small studio's worst week
scenes.say: A small web studio has four clients and two thousand six hundred dollars overdue. Past Due Desk is an agent that works the list for the owner, through PayPal.

scenes.title: Plan with AI: one strategy per client
scenes.say: Plan with AI reads each client's history and picks a strategy: a friendly nudge, a split payment, a settlement discount, or handing a sensitive case back to the owner.

scenes.title: The email it wrote, and why
scenes.say: Every plan comes with its reasoning and the email. Northside Auto asked to pay in parts, so the agent offers a first payment of three hundred seventy five dollars.

scenes.title: Sent as real PayPal invoices
scenes.say: Approved plans go out as real PayPal invoices in the sandbox, with partial payment set to the agent's minimum.

scenes.title: Paid, synced, followed up
lines: on schedule until it is paid.
scenes.say: Refresh from PayPal reads the payments back, and scheduled follow-ups keep going until each invoice is paid or the owner takes over.

scenes.title: Collections board in AG Studio
scenes.say: The collections board, built in A G Studio, shows who still owes what, what the agent proposed and what came back.

scenes.title: Tested
scenes.say: It is tested end to end. Try the hosted demo; start over from the sample books gives every judge a clean desk.
